description: Search City of Puyallup GIS open geospatial datasets (parcels, zoning, public works & city services) by keyword. Returns each dataset's name, summary, record_count, owner/org, and its Feature Service `url` — pass that url to query_layer / layer_info.

org_id.description: Optional ArcGIS orgId to override the default (City of Puyallup GIS).
